hooks.basisCli: As the coding agent lists them now for this session's settings. The session read its own when it started.
hooks.basisLaunch: As the session's settings files were when it started. The coding agent doesn't say which of them it loaded.
hooks.firedWhat: Hive's own hooks it received, newest first (the last 50): Hive's reply, and what Hive made of it. Other hooks aren't seen by Hive.
hooks.ledger: {ledger, select, applied {Applied} continued {Carried on by Hive} ignored {Ignored} other {Not reached}}
hooks.notRunning: The agent isn't running: its hooks are listed while it runs.
hooks.note.changed: {file} has changed since the session started. This list is the session's start; what it loads now isn't known.
hooks.note.cliUnknown: The coding agent couldn't list its hooks ({why}): only Hive's are shown, and whether others load isn't known.
hooks.note.more: {n, plural, one {# more hook} other {# more hooks}} not listed.
hooks.note.notJson: {file} isn't valid JSON, so the coding agent skips it: its hooks aren't listed.
hooks.note.othersUnread: The coding agent may also load hooks Hive doesn't read (its own plugins, the folder's). Only Hive's are listed.
hooks.note.unreadable: {file} couldn't be read ({why}): its hooks aren't listed.
hooks.response: {response, select, none {Nothing to say} context {Sent context} allowed {Allowed} warned {Allowed, with a warning} asked {Asked you} blocked {Blocked} error {Error} other {Unknown}}
hooks.source: {source, select, hive {Hive} managed {Managed settings} cli {Command line} project {Project} local {Project (local)} user {User} plugin {Plugin} other {Other}}
hooks.stale: The agent has restarted since this was read: it shows its earlier session.
hooks.status: {status, select, passed {Passed by Hive} trusted {Trusted} untrusted {Not trusted: won't run} modified {Changed since trusted: won't run} unverified {Configured · loading unverified} disabled {Turned off} notLoaded {Not loaded} unsupported {Unknown form} other {Unknown}}
hooks.title: Hooks: {agent}
hooks.what: The hooks this agent's session has, and what Hive received from them. Hive only shows them here: it never changes or turns off a hook.
